rcb-home-recent.query: SELECT CASE WHEN m.venue_id IN (SELECT venue_id FROM venues WHERE name LIKE '%Chinnaswamy%') THEN 'home' ELSE 'away' END loc, CASE WHEN CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) >= 2023 THEN 'recent' ELSE 'early' END era, SUM(CASE WHEN m.winner_id IN (2,15) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) won, COUNT(*) n FROM matches m WHERE (m.team1_id IN (2,15) OR m.team2_id IN (2,15)) AND m.winner_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY loc, era

toss-field-recent.label: Toss winners choosing to bowl first at Chinnaswamy, 2023–2026
toss-field-recent.dataset: CricField warehouse: matches ⨝ innings ⨝ deliveries ⨝ venues (Cricsheet, IPL 2008–2026)
toss-field-recent.query: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN toss_decision = 'field' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) field, COUNT(*) n FROM matches m WHERE m.venue_id IN (SELECT venue_id FROM venues WHERE name LIKE '%Chinnaswamy%') AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) >= 2023

venue-profile.label: Chinnaswamy vs all other IPL venues
venue-profile.dataset: CricField warehouse: matches ⨝ innings ⨝ deliveries ⨝ venues (Cricsheet, IPL 2008–2026)
venue-profile.query: SELECT CASE WHEN m.venue_id IN (SELECT venue_id FROM venues WHERE name LIKE '%Chinnaswamy%') THEN 'chinnaswamy' ELSE 'other' END venue, COUNT(DISTINCT m.match_id) matches, SUM(d.total_runs) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 END) rr, SUM(CASE WHEN d.batter_runs = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT m.match_id) sixes_pm, SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 GROUP BY venue ;; SELECT CASE WHEN m.venue_id IN (SELECT venue_id FROM venues WHERE name LIKE '%Chinnaswamy%') THEN 'chinnaswamy' ELSE 'other' END venue, AVG(i.runs) avg_first, COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN m.winner_id IS NOT NULL AND m.winner_id <> i.batting_team_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) chase_wins, SUM(CASE WHEN m.winner_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) decided FROM innings i JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = i.match_id WHERE i.innings_number = 1 GROUP BY venue

first-innings-by-season.label: Average first-innings score: Chinnaswamy vs IPL
first-innings-by-season.dataset: CricField warehouse: matches ⨝ innings ⨝ deliveries ⨝ venues (Cricsheet, IPL 2008–2026)
first-innings-by-season.filters: First innings; seasons in which Chinnaswamy hosted (none in 2009, 2020–2022)
first-innings-by-season.query: SELECT CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, AVG(CASE WHEN m.venue_id IN (SELECT venue_id FROM venues WHERE name LIKE '%Chinnaswamy%') THEN i.runs END) chin, AVG(i.runs) league, SUM(CASE WHEN m.venue_id IN (SELECT venue_id FROM venues WHERE name LIKE '%Chinnaswamy%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) chin_n FROM innings i JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = i.match_id WHERE i.innings_number = 1 GROUP BY year HAVING chin_n > 0 ORDER BY year
